name: Five-colourings of complete graphs without monochromatic four-cycles (R_5(K2,2))
description: construct() -> {'n': n, 'colors': [...]}: one colour in {0,...,4} for each pair (i,j), i<j, of vertices 0..n-1 in lexicographic order, 1 <= n <= 29. No colour class may contain a four-cycle (no two vertices with two common neighbours in one colour). Maximize n. A valid 5-colouring of K_n certifies R_5(C4) > n. The algebraic construction of Lazebnik and Woldar gives 26 vertices; 27 or 28 would be new.

sources.locator: Felix Lazebnik and Andrew J. Woldar, New Lower Bounds on the Multicolor Ramsey Numbers r_k(C4) (2000). Crossref record inspected; survey DS1.18 section 6.3.2 inspected: 27 <= R_5(C4) <= 29 [LaWo1] and R_k(C4) >= k^2+2 for odd prime powers k. A valid 5-colouring of K_n certifies R_5(C4) > n. The algebraic construction of Lazebnik and Woldar gives 26 vertices; 27 or 28 would be new.
